instruction: I prefer using spaces instead of tabs in my code. Search for how to configure Vim to insert spaces when I press the Tab key and apply this setting permanently.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for how to use spaces instead of tabs in Vim, then editing ~/.vimrc to add 'set expandtab' or 'set et'. The evaluator checks if the .vimrc file contains the expand tab setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Shell script grep pattern correctly uses word boundaries to avoid false positives: pattern '^:?set (expandtab|et)($|[[:space:]])' ensures 'set et' won't match 'set ethernet'
The evaluator correctly checks ~/.vimrc for permanent configuration
The evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: 'set expandtab' or 'set et' enables space insertion when Tab is pressed
The data flow is correct: shell script checks vimrc -> returns success message -> metric checks for success message
Pattern handles both 'set' and ':set' syntax which are both valid in vimrc files
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the instruction requirement to apply the setting permanently
